requirement: v3.2.7: GPW panel token input plus AI risk grading -- red pauses and needs explicit human confirmation, yellow counts down 180s then executes the AI recommendation, blue 30s, green 3s default allow; without a token the legacy pending timeout is preserved

assertions.levels: countdowns: red 0 (manual confirmation), yellow 180000 ms, blue 30000 ms, green 3000 ms; overrides may tune them but red can never be given a countdown
assertions.actions: green always allows; yellow/blue execute the AI recommendation (deny only when the model recommends deny); red never auto-resolves
assertions.host: every pending entry carries level/ai/countdown_ms/deadline_at; AI classification reschedules the countdown when the level changes; classification failures fall back to the rule colour instead of widening permissions
assertions.routes: GET /api/w2m/gpw/ai (status), POST /api/w2m/gpw/ai/config (DPAPI-persisted token, sharing the decision-center key by default), POST /api/w2m/gpw/ai/test (connectivity + sample classification)
assertions.client: the GPW panel shows the AI settings block (provider/model/baseUrl/token/save/test), pending rows show level + AI recommendation + countdown, and a red pending raises a confirmation dialog with 确认允许/确认拒绝
assertions.fallback: with no token, the legacy single pending timeout behaviour is unchanged, so existing installations and the existing GPW suites keep passing
assertions.proof: gpw-ai 8/8 unit tests; existing GPW suites green; client-bundle 36/36; real Chromium probe asserts the GPW panel carries the AI settings section; loader-entry 10/10; claims green; eslint 0 errors
